## Load all packages

```{r}

library("rlang")
library("Seurat");
library("sctransform");
library("dplyr");
library("RColorBrewer");
library("ggthemes");
library("ggplot2");
library("cowplot");
library("data.table");
library("scales")

```


```{r}
## Read in the feature-barcode matrices generated by the cellranger pipeline.

memory.limit(size=50000000)

samples=c("xu1","xu2","xu3","xu27","xu30","xu31")

data.10x = list()

data.10x[[1]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu01_2017_cus_CR310_56/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[2]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu02_2017_cus_CR310_56/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[3]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu03_2017_cus_CR310_56/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[4]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu27/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[5]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu30_B73_whole/raw_feature_bc_matrix");

data.10x[[6]] <- Read10X(data.dir = "xu31_B73_whole/raw_feature_bc_matrix");


```

```{r}
## Convert each feature-barcode matrix to a Seurat object.

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list = list(); # First create an empty list to hold the Seurat objects

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[1]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[1]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]][["DataSet"]] = samples[1];

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[2]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[2]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]][["DataSet"]] = samples[2];

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[3]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[3]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]][["DataSet"]] = samples[3];

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[4]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[4]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]][["DataSet"]] = samples[4];

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[5]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[5]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]][["DataSet"]] = samples[5];

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]] = CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.10x[[6]], min.cells=3, min.features=200, project=samples[6]);

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]][["DataSet"]] = samples[6];

```


```{r}
### subset each library before merge or integrate

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]] <- subset(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]], subset = nCount_RNA > 5000 & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 150000 & nFeature_RNA < 15000)

```


```{r}
##  logNormalize

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]]<- NormalizeData(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]]<- NormalizeData(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]]<- NormalizeData(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]]<- NormalizeData(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]]<- NormalizeData(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]], normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

```


```{r}
## Find variables


scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[1]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[2]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[3]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[4]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[5]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]]<- FindVariableFeatures(scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list[[6]], selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)


```

```{r}
## Next Integration of 6 replicates 

# find anchors

anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list, anchor.features = features)

anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = scrna_1.2.3.27.30.31.list)


```


```{r}
# Integrate data

Whole.ear.int <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors)



```

```{r}

DefaultAssay(Whole.ear.int)<-"integrated"

# Run the standard workflow for visualization and clustering
Whole.ear.int <- ScaleData(Whole.ear.int, verbose = FALSE)
Whole.ear.int <- RunPCA(Whole.ear.int, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)




```



```{r}
## Determine the ‘dimensionality’ of the dataset

ElbowPlot(Whole.ear.int, ndims = 40)

## Elbow plot: quantitative approach
## https://hbctraining.github.io/scRNA-seq/lessons/elbow_plot_metric.html

# Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
pct <- Whole.ear.int[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(Whole.ear.int[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100

# Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
cumu <- cumsum(pct)

# Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]

co1

# Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1

# last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
co2

# Minimum of the two calculation
pcs <- min(co1, co2)

pcs

```



```{r}
Whole.ear.int <- RunUMAP(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) ## Use PC number based on above Elbow plot: quantitative approach

Whole.ear.int <- FindNeighbors(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

Whole.ear.int <- FindClusters(Whole.ear.int, resolution = 0.8)

# Visualization

DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1)
DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

## two plots next to each other 

p1 <- DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2

### split the UMAPs by samples 

DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", split.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)


### group the UMAPs by samples. 

DimPlot(Whole.ear.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)

```


```{r}
## save 

saveRDS(Whole.ear.int, file = "Whole.ear.int.rds")

```


```{r}
## Subcluster to separate meristem base and adaxial meristem periphery

subcluster.base.periphery <- subset(Whole.ear.int, idents = c("10"))

DefaultAssay(subcluster.base.periphery)<-"integrated"

subcluster.base.periphery <- ScaleData(subcluster.base.periphery, verbose = FALSE)

subcluster.base.periphery <- RunPCA(subcluster.base.periphery, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)


ElbowPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, ndims = 40)

## Elbow plot: quantitative approach
## https://hbctraining.github.io/scRNA-seq/lessons/elbow_plot_metric.html

# Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
pct <- subcluster.base.periphery[["pca"]]@stdev / sum(subcluster.base.periphery[["pca"]]@stdev) * 100

# Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
cumu <- cumsum(pct)

# Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]

co1

# Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1

# last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
co2


# Minimum of the two calculation
pcs <- min(co1, co2)

pcs

subcluster.base.periphery <- RunUMAP(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs) ## Use PC number based on above Elbow plot: quantitative approach

subcluster.base.periphery <- FindNeighbors(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:pcs)

subcluster.base.periphery <- FindClusters(subcluster.base.periphery, resolution = 0.2)

# Visualization

DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1)
DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")

## two plots next to each other 

p1 <- DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2


subcluster.base.periphery <- RenameIdents(object = subcluster.base.periphery, '0' = 'meristem.periphery', '1' = 'meristem.base')

p1 <- DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 1)
p2 <- DimPlot(subcluster.base.periphery, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1, label.size = 10)
p1 + p2


saveRDS(subcluster.base.periphery, file = "subcluster.base.periphery.rds")


Whole.ear.int.subcluster <- Whole.ear.int

Whole.ear.int.subcluster$base_periphery <- as.character(Idents(Whole.ear.int.subcluster))

Whole.ear.int.subcluster$base_periphery[Cells(subcluster.base.periphery)] <- paste(Idents(subcluster.base.periphery))

DimPlot(Whole.ear.int.subcluster, reduction = "umap", group.by = "base_periphery", label = TRUE)

Idents(Whole.ear.int.subcluster) <- "base_periphery"


DimPlot(Whole.ear.int.subcluster, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

```



```{r}

library(Seurat)

## 1) load the already-annotated object
whole.ear.final <- readRDS("whole.ear.final.rds")

## 2) final cluster colors (taken from whole-ear DimPlot)
cluster.colors <- c(
  "S.Phase.(non.epi.I)"="#afbca5","S.Phase.(non.epi.II)"="#7CAE00","S.Phase.(non.epi.III)"="#0CB702",
  "S.Phase.(epi)"="#98fb98",
  "G2.M.Phase.(non.epi.I)"="#99b6ca","G2.M.Phase.(non.epi.II)"="#E68613","G2.M.Phase.(epi)"="#ffa500",
  "Pith"="#95511f","Cortex.I"="#737172","Cortex.II"="#00BFC4",
  "Meristem.Base.I"="#e761d8","Meristem.base.II"="#F8766D",
  "Meristem.Boundary.I"="#1FA195","Meristem.Boundary.II"="#8494FF",
  "Meristem.Tip.I.(non.epi)"="#e93f33","Meristem.Tip.II.(non.epi)"="#4d6dcb",
  "Adaxial.Meristem.Periphery.(non.epi)"="#66dcf6","Adaxial.Meristem.Periphery.(epi)"="#D4D915",
  "Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(epi)"="#808000",
  "Adaxial.Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(non-epi)"="#64ac4e",
  "Abaxial.Determinate.Lateral.Organ.(non-epi)"="#f3f550",
  "Stem.epidermis"="#e9967a",
  "Protophloem.Sieve.Elements"="#F68282","Companion.Cells"="#FF61CC",
  "Boundle.Sheath"="#B95FBB","Maturing.Xylem"="#00A9FF","Xylem"="#28CECA")

## 3) check that the saved identities match the color names
cur <- as.character(Idents(whole.ear.final))
print(table(cur))
missing <- setdiff(unique(cur), names(cluster.colors))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("These labels have no color: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

## 4) set identity levels in color order
Idents(whole.ear.final) <- factor(cur, levels = names(cluster.colors)[names(cluster.colors) %in% cur])

## 5) store labels, per-cell colors, and the palette in the object
whole.ear.final$final_annotation <- as.character(Idents(whole.ear.final))
whole.ear.final$final_color <- unname(cluster.colors[whole.ear.final$final_annotation])
whole.ear.final@misc$cluster_colors <- cluster.colors

## 6) check the plot, then save under a new name
DimPlot(whole.ear.final, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 2, pt.size = 1,
        cols = whole.ear.final@misc$cluster_colors)

saveRDS(whole.ear.final, file = "whole.ear.final.updated.color.rds")

```
